---
title: "Course materials"
---

Introduction to R takes three days. Each day has its own section, with
the materials for that day:

- [**Day 1 – Getting started:**](day-1/introduction.qmd) R and RStudio,
  and reading your data into R.
- [**Day 2 – Data wrangling:**](day-2/tidy-data.qmd) tidy data, and
  filtering, selecting and reshaping your data.
- [**Day 3 – Plotting:**](day-3/introduction-to-ggplot2.qmd) making and
  customising plots with ggplot2.
